adjust.previewMessage:
Changing the bucket count requires rebuilding the table, which performs the following steps:
1. Create a new table (bucket count: {{buckets}})
2. Migrate data
3. Rename tables

This requires the ALTER TABLE privilege and locks the table for a while.

Continue?
adjust.rangeHint: Range: 1-128. Use the recommended value or adjust based on data volume
adjust.recommendedHint: Recommended value is based on data size (about 1 bucket per 10 GB)

warnings.w1: Adjusting buckets requires rebuilding the table, which is time-consuming
warnings.w2: The table is locked during the rebuild and cannot be read or written
warnings.w3: Make sure there is enough storage space for data migration
warnings.w4: Perform this operation during off-peak hours
warnings.w5: This operation requires the ALTER TABLE and CREATE TABLE privileges

bucket.cardinalityHigh: Distribution key cardinality is high; data should be evenly distributed
bucket.cardinalityLow: Distribution key cardinality is too low and may cause bucket skew; use a high-cardinality column as the distribution key
bucket.cardinalityMedium: Distribution key cardinality is moderate; monitor for bucket skew
bucket.distributionCloudNative: This is a CLOUD_NATIVE table whose data is stored in object storage; be_tablets has no data, so BE-level distribution analysis is not supported
bucket.distributionNoData: This table has no data in be_tablets (it may be a CLOUD_NATIVE or external table), so BE-level distribution analysis is not supported
bucket.skewCloudNative: This is a CLOUD_NATIVE table whose data is stored in object storage; be_tablets has no data, so bucket skew analysis is not supported
bucket.skewNoData: This table has no data in be_tablets (it may be a CLOUD_NATIVE or external table), so bucket skew analysis is not supported
